sentences.text: Today, we are going to talk about Columbia.
Columbia is a very beautiful and interesting country.
It has amazing places, delicious food, and friendly people.
One, where is Columbia?
Columbia is in South America.
It is in the north of the continent.
Columbia has borders with Venezuela, Brazil, Peru, Ecuador, and Panama.
Columbia is special because it has two coasts.
It touches the Caribbean Sea and the Pacific Ocean.
This means Columbia has many beautiful beaches.
The capital city of Columbia is Bogota.
Bogota is a big city in the mountains.
More than 7 million people live there.
Other big cities in Columbia are Medellin, Cali, and Cartagena.
Nature in Columbia.
Columbia has amazing nature.
There are mountains, rainforests, rivers, and beaches.
The Andes Mountains go through Columbia.
Many people visit these mountains to see the beautiful views.
Columbia also has part of the Amazon rainforest.
The Amazon is the biggest rainforest in the world.
It has many trees, plants, and animals.
A famous place in Columbia is Canyo Cristales.
It is called the River of Five Colors because the water looks red, yellow, green, blue, and black.
Columbia also has beautiful beaches.
The Caribbean beaches have white sand and clear blue water.
People love to visit islands like San Andres and Providencia.
Three animals in Columbia.
Columbia has many animals.
It is one of the most biodiverse countries in the world.
One famous animal in Columbia is the Andean Condor.
It is a very big bird.
It is the national bird of Columbia.
Another special animal is the Pink River Dolphin.
This dolphin lives in the Amazon River.
It is not gray like other dolphins.
It is pink.
Columbia also has jaguars, monkeys, colorful frogs, and many birds.
There are more than 1,900 types of birds in Columbia.
Four food in Columbia.
Colombian food is delicious.
Here are some famous dishes.
Arepas.
Arepas are round corn cakes.
People eat them with butter, cheese, or meat.
Bandeja paisa.
This is a big meal with rice, beans, meat, plantains, avocado, and an egg.
It is very popular in Medellin.
Ahiaco.
This is a special soup from Bogota.
It has chicken, potatoes, corn, and herbs.
Empanadas.
These are small fried pastries filled with meat, potatoes, or cheese.
Sankocho.
This is a soup with meat, yucca, plantains, and corn.
Colombians love to drink coffee.
Colombian coffee is famous around the world.
It is rich and smooth.
Many people visit Columbia to see the coffee farms in the mountains.
People and language.
Columbia has a population of over 50 million people.
Most people in Columbia speak Spanish, but Columbia also has over 60 indigenous languages.
Colombians are very friendly and welcoming.
They like to dance, celebrate, and enjoy life.
One popular dance in Columbia is cumbia.
Cumbia is a traditional dance with drums and flutes.
Another famous dance is salsa.
The city of Cali is called the capital of the world.
Festivals in Columbia?
Columbia has many festivals.
People love music, dancing, and celebrations.
One famous festival is Carnival de Barranquilla.
It is the second biggest carnival in the world.
People wear colorful costumes and dance in the streets.
Another special festival is Feria de las Flores in Medellin.
This is the flower festival.
People make big flower displays and have a parade.
In Bogota, there is a big music festival called Rock al Parque.
It is one of the biggest free rock festivals in Latin America.
History and culture.
Columbia has a rich history.
A long time ago, indigenous people lived in Columbia.
One famous indigenous group was the Muisca.
They believed in a golden king.
This is where the legend of El Dorado comes from.
Today, Columbia is a mix of indigenous, Spanish, and African cultures.
This mix makes Columbia unique and colorful.
Columbia is also famous for Gabriel Garcia Marquez.
He was a writer who won the Nobel Prize in Literature.
His most famous book is 100 Years of Solitude.
That is all for today.
Now you know many things about Columbia.
It is a beautiful country with amazing people, food, and culture.
